elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] You've been taking screenshots the hard way.

[confident] Here's the fix. Press Windows, Shift, S.

[friendly] Drag a box around what you want. It's already on your clipboard. On a Mac, it's Command, Shift, 4.

[delighted] No full screenshot, no cropping.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
